data.report: Veikkausliiga 2019-2026 source-mapping + API-Football audit. (1) muse_response: req-20261003-011 response hash MATCHES its request hash (e1ae0f228db7b546) → valid for ingestion (466 rows, per-season audits, 5 unresolved). (2) api_football: BLOCKED – no API_FOOTBALL_KEY in current process; non-secret config delivered (env var, base URL, /leagues + /fixtures endpoint family, field mapping); league id 244 commonly documented but UNVERIFIED; historical seasons likely need paid plan. (3) Source mapping: 10 rows – veikkausliiga.com is text-fetchable (server-rendered; schedule subpage URL + round labelling still to confirm), Palloliitto Tulospalvelu (federation, Kierros grouping, fetch untested), WorldFootball.net (static round-grouped pages, cross-check only), soccerassociation.com (round pages, cross-check), RSSSF (tables only), Wikipedia season pages (results matrix), fi.wikipedia season tables + Veikkausliiga grounds list (venue_by_season candidates, verified for 1990s), OSM Nominatim (coordinates, verified working). meeting_number: no official source defines it – expect NULL.

muse_response.summary: req-20261003-011 response hash MATCHES its current request hash, so the conditional invalidation in req-20261004-004 Q2 does NOT trigger: the response is valid for ingestion. Contents: status=ok, from=muse, 466 row-level evidence rows (data.rows), per-season audit (seasons audited: 2019-2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026; e.g. 2023: expected 167 / discovered 167 / complete 167 from openfootball 'europe finland/2023_fi1.txt' source_sha256_16 693f5157e8077c55), unresolved_queue with 5 items.
muse_response.what_a_fresh_valid_response_must_contain: Only relevant if a future request_sha mismatch occurs. A fresh valid response must contain: id, status=ok, from=muse, request_sha = sha256(requests/<id>.json)[:16] computed at write time, data.rows (row-level evidence with source_url/final_url/retrieved_at/field_locator), data.audit (expected/discovered/complete/partial/missing per season), data.unresolved_queue (missing/blocked stay listed with reasons), dp_used declaration. It must NOT treat any old processing/error/unavailable response as data.
